dialogue.content: こんばんわ
dialogue.English: Good evening.

dialogue.content: こんばんは。
dialogue.English: Good evening.

dialogue.content: 少し早いですが、ご準備が良ければ、始めさせて頂いて、大丈夫ですか？
dialogue.English: It’s a little early, but if you’re ready, is it alright if we get started?

dialogue.content: はい大丈夫です。
dialogue.English: Yes, that’s fine.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いします
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: よろしくお願いいたします
dialogue.English: Thank you as well.

dialogue.content: こんばんわ、相談員です。今日はどのようなご相談ですか？
dialogue.English: Good evening, I'm the counselor. What would you like to talk about today?

dialogue.content: はい、主人から生活費を十分にもらえなくて…
dialogue.English: Yes, my husband doesn’t give me enough money for living expenses...

dialogue.content: どしたらいいでしょうか？
dialogue.English: What should I do?

dialogue.content: ご主人さんから、生活費を・・それはお辛いですね
dialogue.English: Not getting enough for living expenses from your husband... That must be very difficult for you.

dialogue.content: はい、私もパートの仕事はしてるのですがそれだけでは足りないんです
dialogue.English: Yes, I work part-time, but that alone isn't enough.

dialogue.content: そうですよね・・いつからそのような辛い事になったのですか？
dialogue.English: I see... When did this difficult situation begin?

dialogue.content: もう、ずっとです
dialogue.English: It's been like this for a long time.

dialogue.content: ずっと・・それは計り知れない苦労をされておられます。
dialogue.English: For so long... You must have gone through unimaginable hardship.

dialogue.content: 結婚されてからですか？
dialogue.English: Has it been this way since you got married?

dialogue.content: はい…妊娠していた時に一度だけ殴られて、それからですかね…
dialogue.English: Yes... He hit me once when I was pregnant, and I think it started around then...

dialogue.content: 一度だけ殴られて・・それから生活費を十分にもらえずに、家計のやりくりを？
dialogue.English: He hit you once... and since then, he hasn't given you enough for living expenses, and you've had to juggle the household budget?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 月に十万円しかくれないのです
dialogue.English: He only gives me 100,000 yen a month.

dialogue.content: 子供も中学生でよく食べるようになってきてとても困ってます
dialogue.English: Our child is in junior high and eats a lot now, so it's become very difficult.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。家族の人数や各家庭の消費量はマチマチでしょうが、あきらかに足りないとお感じなのですね？
dialogue.English: I see. While family size and household expenses vary, you clearly feel that it's not enough, is that right?

dialogue.content: はい、学校からの集金とか光熱費とか、そうですね…
dialogue.English: Yes, with things like school fees, utility bills... that's right.

dialogue.content: 主人はとても細かくてガソリン代などもいちいち、私に払えと言ってきます
dialogue.English: My husband is very nitpicky and even tells me to pay for things like gasoline every single time.

dialogue.content: お子さんも育ちざかり、自分のガソリン代まで？ご主人さんからは他に嫌な事とか言われたりしていませんか？
dialogue.English: Your child is growing, and he even asks for his own gas money? Has he said other hurtful things to you?

dialogue.content: 向こうからそういう話をされる以外は、私からは話しかけません。怖いんです…
dialogue.English: Unless he initiates the conversation, I don't talk to him. I'm scared...

dialogue.content: いつもお前が悪いとか無駄遣いするなとかそんなことばかりです
dialogue.English: It's always things like, 'It's your fault,' or 'Stop wasting money.'

dialogue.content: はい。とても怖いですよね。何か言えば、倍になって返ってくる感じ。
dialogue.English: Yes. That must be very frightening. It sounds like if you say something, it comes back at you twice as bad.

dialogue.content: 何十倍でしょうか・・
dialogue.English: Or even tens of times over...

dialogue.content: ええ、、また殴られるかと思ってしまうので…何も言えないですね…
dialogue.English: Yes... I worry he might hit me again, so I can’t say anything...

dialogue.content: でも主人は後輩とかには羽振りが良くてよくおごったりしてるみたいです
dialogue.English: But it seems he's very generous with his junior colleagues and often treats them.

dialogue.content: 気持ちはきっと何十倍と怖いですよね・・殴られたのは一度とのことですが、殴られそうな空気だったりがおありの様子が感じられます。後輩には・・そうですか。良い顔をされるんですね。
dialogue.English: The fear you feel must be many times worse... You said he only hit you once, but I can sense there's an atmosphere where you feel he might hit you again. And with his junior colleagues... I see. He puts on a good face for them.

dialogue.content: でも、うちでは帰ってくると自分の部屋にまっすぐ入って、1人で買ってきたご飯を食べてるのであまり顔を合わせなくて済んでます
dialogue.English: But at home, when he comes back, he goes straight to his room and eats the food he bought for himself, so we don’t have to see each other much.

dialogue.content: 一緒に食事はされていないんですね？
dialogue.English: So you don't eat meals together?

dialogue.content: はい家庭内別居な感じです
dialogue.English: Yes, it feels like we’re living separately under the same roof.

dialogue.content: そうですか。複雑なお気持ちでしょう・・お子さんはお母さんと食事されているのですか？
dialogue.English: I see. You must have complicated feelings about that... Does your child eat with you?

dialogue.content: はい、そうです。子供は養護学校に通っているので私が世話をしないと
dialogue.English: Yes, they do. My child goes to a special-needs school, so I have to take care of them.

dialogue.content: 送り迎えもあってパートもそんなに入れないので離婚はまだできないと思ってます
dialogue.English: I have to take them to and from school, so I can't work many part-time hours. That's why I feel I can't get a divorce yet.

dialogue.content: そうですか。ご主人の事でもかなり心労がおありなのに、養護学校とは、どこか具合がわるいのですか？
dialogue.English: I see. You're already under a lot of stress because of your husband, and you mentioned a special-needs school... does your child have a health condition?

dialogue.content: はい、自閉症と言われてます
dialogue.English: Yes, they’ve been diagnosed with autism.

dialogue.content: それは・・・相当な苦労を抱えておられます。
dialogue.English: That's... you must be carrying a tremendous burden.

dialogue.content: 主人は消防でお給料はそれなりにあるはずなんです。でも、どうやってお金が足りないと言ったらいいのか…
dialogue.English: My husband is a firefighter, so his salary should be decent. But I just don't know how to tell him that the money isn't enough...

dialogue.content: どちらか一つでも、苦しくて、痛くて、お辛い中。お金の問題が現実としておありですよね。
dialogue.English: Any one of these issues would be painful and difficult enough, but on top of it all, there is this very real problem of money.

dialogue.content: はい、そうなんです。。
dialogue.English: Yes, that’s right...

dialogue.content: お金話をしたらどんな返事が返ってきますか？
dialogue.English: When you bring up money, what kind of response do you get?

dialogue.content: 細かいので何で足りないんだ、といって取り合ってくれません。それ以上、私も言えなくなるので…
dialogue.English: He's very nitpicky, so he just says, 'Why isn't it enough?' and won't listen. After that, I can't say anything more...

dialogue.content: 具体的に、学校でこれだけ必要だと言ったらくれた事もありましたけど…
dialogue.English: There were times when, if I said specifically how much was needed for school, he did give it to me...

dialogue.content: そうですか。やりくりが下手だとか言って怒られるんですね。でも学校は他者がからんでるから出してくれるのでしょうか・・お子さんだからでしょうか・・
dialogue.English: I see. So he gets angry and says you're bad at managing money. But perhaps he gives you the money for school because other people are involved... or because it's for your child...

dialogue.content: よく分からないんです。すみません…
dialogue.English: I’m not really sure. I’m sorry...

dialogue.content: いえ、こちらこそ、苦しい質問してしまいました。すみません。病気のお子さんを抱えて、パートだし、本当によく耐えてご主人の厳しさにも耐えて、
dialogue.English: No, not at all, I'm the one who asked a difficult question. I'm sorry. You have a child with special needs, you're working part-time, and you're truly enduring so much, including your husband's harshness.

dialogue.content: お金が足りない生活を、ご主人と話し合って乗り越えていきたい所、
dialogue.English: You'd like to discuss the lack of money with your husband and overcome this together,

dialogue.content: また怒られるのではと、耐えておられるんですよね・・
dialogue.English: but you’re holding back because you’re afraid he’ll get angry again, right...?

dialogue.content: はい、毎回これに必要だからとお願いするのも、なんだか苦しくて
dialogue.English: Yes, it's just so painful to have to ask him every single time, saying, 'I need it for this.'

dialogue.content: はい、
dialogue.English: Yes,

dialogue.content: 色々苦しいものを抱えていらっしゃって、どれをとっても、苦しいのですが、今一番何とかしたいと思われる事は、どの事かお答えできますか？
dialogue.English: You are carrying so many painful things, and each one is difficult, but if you can, could you tell me what is the one thing you most want to resolve right now?

dialogue.content: はい、生活費を主人からもらうよい方法がないか知りたいです
dialogue.English: Yes, I’d like to know if there’s a good way to get living expenses from my husband.

dialogue.content: そうですよね、何も言わず本当はスッと出して欲しいですよね
dialogue.English: I understand. You really just wish he would give it to you without you having to say anything.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 少し整理させていただきますね
dialogue.English: Let me try to summarize things a bit, okay?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: ご主人さんは細かいお方です。消防にお勤めで、厳しい仕事で奥様にも厳しいです。
dialogue.English: Your husband is a nitpicky person. He works as a firefighter, a demanding job, and he is also demanding with you.

dialogue.content: はい、そうです
dialogue.English: Yes, that’s right.

dialogue.content: 後輩には羽振りが良くて、外向きはいい顔をされる。
dialogue.English: He's generous with his junior colleagues and puts on a good face for outsiders.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 奥様のやりくりを恐らく一番に責めてこられます。
dialogue.English: And he most likely blames you first for not managing the money well.

dialogue.content: 細かい厳しいお方なんですね
dialogue.English: He's a nitpicky and strict person.

dialogue.content: はいそうです
dialogue.English: Yes, he is.

dialogue.content: ここで一緒に考えてみたいのですが、お子さんに対してはお金は出せそうな感じなんでしょうか
dialogue.English: I’d like to think this through together—does it seem like he would be willing to spend money when it’s for your child?

dialogue.content: その、ガソリン代の時もいつもは定期でバスなんです。でも1時間に2本しかなくてどうしても車で迎えに行かなくてはならなくて車を使ったんですけど、ガソリン減ってるから使った分を払えと。
dialogue.English: Well, about the gas money... I usually take the bus with a pass. But there are only two buses an hour, so I absolutely had to use the car to pick up my child. And he said the gas was low, so I had to pay for what I used.

dialogue.content: 子供を迎えに行っただけなんですけど…
dialogue.English: Even though I just went to pick up our child...

dialogue.content: はい、お子さんのお迎えすら・・ですね。
dialogue.English: Yes, even for picking up your child...

dialogue.content: 全然面倒を見ないしあまりかわいがってくれません…
dialogue.English: He doesn’t take care of them at all and doesn’t show much affection...

dialogue.content: そうですか。とても悲しい現実と向き合っておられて、相当我慢されておられますね。
dialogue.English: I see. You’re facing a very sad reality and enduring a great deal.

dialogue.content: でも、現実のお金さえ今はもらえれば、
dialogue.English: But, if you could just get the money you need for now,

dialogue.content: と強い気持ちで母として生きておられて、
dialogue.English: you’re living with that strong resolve as a mother,

dialogue.content: 私がこの子の面倒を見ないとどうにもならないので、せめて生活費を、と思います。
dialogue.English: I'm the only one who can take care of my child, so at the very least, I need the living expenses.

dialogue.content: ご主人に優しさよりも、今は何とかしてお金ですよね
dialogue.English: More than kindness from your husband, right now, it's about the money, isn't it?

dialogue.content: 二つ思ったのですがよろしいですか？
dialogue.English: I have two thoughts—may I share them?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: きっとご主人はこの先も同じかもしれないです。ひどくなるかもしれないですね。
dialogue.English: Your husband may well stay the same going forward. It could even get worse.

dialogue.content: ひどくなりますか？
dialogue.English: Will he get worse?

dialogue.content: いえ、わからないのですが、良くなると思ってひどくなるより、ひどくなると思って向き合うほうが、色んな覚悟が出来るかと思われます
dialogue.English: No, I can't say for sure, but I think it's better to face this situation prepared for it to get worse, rather than hoping for improvement only to be disappointed. That way, you can prepare yourself for different possibilities.

dialogue.content: はい、そうならないようにずっと我慢してきたのですがやはり無駄でしょうか…
dialogue.English: Yes... I've been enduring this for so long, hoping it wouldn't get worse. Was it all for nothing...?

dialogue.content: すみませんでした。お時間いただいて申し訳ありません。
dialogue.English: I'm sorry for taking up so much of your time.

dialogue.content: 無駄ではないです。頑張ってこられたからここまでこれたと思います。そんな辛抱中々出来ないと思います。とても尊敬いたします。ご主人さまにこのままお金を貰いたい気持ちでいるならば、二人のお子様の事に関係するお金はしっかり欲しいとお伝えしてはいかがでしょうか。時間ですね
dialogue.English: It wasn't for nothing. I believe you've come this far because you've worked so hard. Not many people could endure what you have. I have great respect for you. If you wish to continue receiving money from your husband, how about clearly telling him that you need money for things related to your child? Ah, our time is almost up.

dialogue.content: もう少しだけ時間頂けないでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Could I have just a little more of your time?

dialogue.content: はい、、
dialogue.English: Yes...

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。二つ目の想いは
dialogue.English: Thank you. The second thing I was thinking was,

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 奥様側のご両親や家族さんで助けてもらえる人がもしいらっしゃるならば、
dialogue.English: if you have parents or family on your side who might be able to help,

dialogue.content: お金の面とは言えませんが、送迎だったり預かりだったりで助けてもらえたら、少し稼げる方法ができたらと、思いました・
dialogue.English: not necessarily with money, but if they could help with things like transportation or watching your child, I thought that might create an opportunity for you to earn a little more.

dialogue.content: あきらめないで下さいね
dialogue.English: Please don’t give up.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: とても強くてこんなに頑張ってるお母さんはお子さんには一人しかいませんものね。自信をもっていただきたいです。
dialogue.English: Your child has only one mother who is so strong and trying so hard. I want you to have confidence in yourself.

dialogue.content: すみません、遅くなりましたので、終了させていただきますが、応援しております
dialogue.English: I'm sorry, we've gone over time, so I'll have to end the session here, but I am rooting for you.

dialogue.content: 相談できるか、考えてみます。親には主人のことは話せていないので
dialogue.English: I’ll think about whether I can talk to them. I haven’t been able to tell my parents about my husband.

dialogue.content: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you very much.

dialogue.content: はい、ありがとうございました。ご両親が助けて下さりますように・・・
dialogue.English: Yes, thank you as well. I hope your parents will be able to help you...

dialogue.content: 終了ボタンを押しますね
dialogue.English: I’ll press the end button now.

dialogue.content: はい！ありがとうございました！！
dialogue.English: Yes! Thank you very much!!
